summary: Phase 6.2: clip tagging UI — ClipTagScreen with cue-select, scrub bar, ±1 frame buttons, in-place Dexie update. New module `app/src/clipmode/tag.ts` exports `FRAME_STEP_MS = 1000/30`, `stepFrame(currentMs, delta, durationMs)`, and `clampCueAtMs(cueAtMs, durationMs)` as pure helpers (11 tests). Library gains `getClip(id)` and `updateClipTag(id, { cueId, cueAtMs })` — clamps cueAtMs to [0, durationMs] and overwrites in place (5 new tests, 28 total in library.test.ts; was 23). New `app/src/ui/ClipTagScreen.tsx` (chunk: 3.08 KB / 1.22 KB gzip, lazy-loaded via React.lazy matching the PairScreen / ClipLibraryScreen idiom) renders <video controls> on a blob URL, a range-input scrub bar bound to cueAtMs, ±1 frame buttons, an 8-option cue-type select sourced from `CUE_LIBRARY`, and a Save button that persists via `updateClipTag` and shows a saved-indicator. Prefills cueId + cueAtMs from the existing clip record if a prior tag exists. New `app/src/ui/ClipTagScreen.test.tsx` covers cue-id selection + persistence (7 tests via @testing-library/react): persists cueId+cueAtMs through Save, prefills prior tag, renders all 8 CUE_LIBRARY entries, frame +/-1 ms math with clamping, closes on missing clipId, **creates exactly one blob URL per clipId across Save** (regression for code-reviewer B2 — setClip(updated) churn removed), and **does not refetch on onClose prop identity change** (regression for B3 — onCloseRef pattern). ClipLibraryScreen exposes a `data-testid='clip-tag-open'` Tag button per row (gated on optional `onTagClip` prop). App.tsx routes `view='tag'` through Suspense → lazy ClipTagScreen with a `taggingClipId` state slot; Close returns to clip library. New `verify-phase6-2.mjs` C1–C4 gate checks (C1 empty library shows no Tag button + import label present; C2 seeded clip shows Tag button + 'needs tag' marker; C3 tag screen renders cue-select with 8 entries + scrub + frame +/- + save + close; C4 Save persists + 'needs tag' marker disappears + reopen prefills 'blitzes'). All four PASS with 0 console errors. M1–M5 manual checklist enumerates real-device QA per QUALITY_GATES.md §B5 (real <video>+blob scrub precision is MANUAL). 25 new vitest tests (238 total, was 213; +5 library + 11 tag.ts + 7 ClipTagScreen). Lint + tsc + vite build all clean. Main bundle 346.98 KB / 107.29 KB gzip (Phase 6.1 baseline 346.49 / 107.15 — delta +0.49 KB raw / +0.14 KB gzip thanks to lazy-loading; ClipTagScreen chunk separated at 3.08 / 1.22). CSS chunk grew +0.95 KB raw / +0.15 KB gzip for `.clip-tag-*` + `.clip-row-actions` styles. Code-reviewer (`code-reviewer` agent) returned REQUEST_CHANGES with 3 blockers + 3 should-fix + 4 nits; all blockers + should-fixes applied before this approval: (B1) verify-phase6-2/results.json re-run cleanly, all four C-checks now PASS; (B2) ClipTagScreen no longer calls `setClip(updated)` on save — `clip` state holds immutable bits only (id/blob/duration), `cueId`+`cueAtMs` are the editable state; blob-URL effect's dep `[clip]` thus never re-fires after initial load, so `<video>` stops churning across Saves; (B3) load effect's deps changed from `[clipId, onClose]` to `[clipId]` with an `onCloseRef` pattern so parent re-renders never trigger a refetch that silently overwrites unsaved edits; (S1) two regression tests added catching B2/B3; (S2) Phase 6.2 testing-strategy lock-in appended to `artifacts/decision-memo.md` documenting why `@testing-library/react` was added as a devDep and the three-layer test architecture going forward (pure logic in *.test.ts, component contracts in *.test.tsx, end-to-end in verify-phaseN.mjs); (S3) `@testing-library/jest-dom` and `@testing-library/user-event` removed from devDependencies — they were never used. Nits N1 (FRAME_STEP_MS rounding drift), N2 (playwright addition appropriate), N3 (data-testid convention compliant), N4 (video sizing fine via CSS) — all explicitly noted as non-blocking by the reviewer and require no code changes.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: From ClipLibraryScreen, 'Tag' opens ClipTagScreen.tsx, prefilled if a prior tag exists
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: `app/src/ui/ClipLibraryScreen.tsx:184-192` renders the `data-testid='clip-tag-open'` button when `onTagClip` prop is provided. `app/src/App.tsx:52-78` routes view='tag' through Suspense → lazy ClipTagScreen with the `taggingClipId` state slot. `ClipTagScreen.test.tsx:80-104` 'prefills cueId + cueAtMs when a prior tag exists' seeds `{ cueId: 'freezes', cueAtMs: 2200 }` into Dexie, renders the screen, and asserts the cue-select reads 'freezes' and the scrub-input value reads '2200'. verify-phase6-2.mjs C4 PASS asserts that reopening Tag after Save shows the cue-select prefilled with 'blitzes'.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Tag screen shows `<video controls>` plus a custom scrub bar with −1 frame and +1 frame buttons (step 1/30s)
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: `ClipTagScreen.tsx:118-126` renders `<video ref={videoRef} controls preload='metadata' data-testid='clip-tag-video'>`. `:128-148` renders a flex row with `data-testid='clip-tag-frame-back'`, a range input `data-testid='clip-tag-scrub'`, and `data-testid='clip-tag-frame-forward'`. The −1/+1 buttons call `handleStep(±1)` which calls `stepFrame(cueAtMs, delta, durationMs)` from `clipmode/tag.ts:23-29`. `FRAME_STEP_MS = 1000/30 ≈ 33.333 ms` per `tag.ts:18` and verified at `tag.test.ts:6-9`. `ClipTagScreen.test.tsx:111-138` 'frame-forward / frame-back buttons adjust cueAtMs by ±33 ms (clamped)' asserts the scrub value walks 0 → 33 → 66 → 33 → 0 (clamped) across click sequences. verify-phase6-2.mjs C3 PASS confirms the scrub + frame-back + frame-forward + save + close + cue-select-with-8-options all render on the same screen.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Cue-type select sources from CUE_LIBRARY (all 8 entries) and writes clip.cueId + clip.cueAtMs back to Dexie via an in-place update
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: `ClipTagScreen.tsx:150-167` renders `<select>` with `CUE_LIBRARY.map((c) => <option ...>)`. `clipmode/library.ts:99-128` `updateClipTag(id, { cueId, cueAtMs })` clamps cueAtMs to `[0, durationMs]` and calls `db.clips.put({ ...existing, cueId, cueAtMs })` (in-place; no schema bump — the cueId/cueAtMs fields are not indexed). `ClipTagScreen.test.tsx:42-78` 'persists the selected cueId + current cueAtMs through Save' selects 'blitzes', scrubs to 1500 ms, clicks Save, then asserts `getClip(id)` returns `{ cueId: 'blitzes', cueAtMs: 1500 }`. `:106-116` 'renders all 8 CUE_LIBRARY entries in the select' asserts the select contains exactly 8 `<option>` elements. `library.test.ts` 'writes cueId + cueAtMs onto an existing clip and returns the updated row' (line ~215), 'overwrites a prior tag in place (no version history)' (~233), 'clamps a negative cueAtMs to 0' (~245), 'clamps cueAtMs to durationMs when over (avoids tagging past end of clip)' (~253), 'returns null when the clip id does not exist' (~261) — all five PASS.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Untagged clips are flagged in the library list ('needs tag') and excluded from playback in 6.3
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: Already shipped in Phase 6.1: `ClipLibraryScreen.tsx:179-188` renders `data-testid='clip-needs-tag'` when `clip.cueId === undefined`. The 'excluded from playback in 6.3' half lights up in 6.3 when `clipmode/runner.ts` filters by `cueId !== undefined`. verify-phase6-2.mjs C2 PASS confirms a freshly-seeded clip (no cueId) shows the 'needs tag' marker; C4 PASS confirms a tagged clip's marker disappears after Save.

`ClipTagScreen.tsx:97-103` `handleSave` calls `updateClipTag(clip.id, { cueId, cueAtMs })` and sets the savedAt indicator. The in-place Dexie put covers persistence across reloads (same mechanism as sessions/reps/profiles). `ClipTagScreen.test.tsx:42-78` round-trips Save → `getClip()` and asserts the persisted value. verify-phase6-2.mjs C4 PASS round-trips Save → Close → re-open via the live app and asserts the cue-select is prefilled with the saved value. M4 in the manual checklist exercises page-reload persistence on a real device per §B5.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: ClipTagScreen.test.tsx covers cue-id selection and persistence with a stubbed <video> element
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: `app/src/ui/ClipTagScreen.test.tsx` is the project's first `.test.tsx` component test, using `@testing-library/react` (added as a devDep in this phase and recorded in `decision-memo.md`'s Phase 6.2 testing-strategy lock-in). 7 tests pass total: cue-id selection + persistence via Save, prefill of prior tag, all 8 CUE_LIBRARY entries rendered, frame ±33 ms math with clamping, close on missing clipId, **regression for code-reviewer B2** ('creates exactly one blob URL per clipId, even after Save (no <video> churn)' — would fail if `setClip(updated)` were restored to `handleSave`), and **regression for code-reviewer B3** ('does not refetch the clip when only the onClose prop identity changes' — would fail if the load effect's deps reverted to include `onClose`). `URL.createObjectURL` / `revokeObjectURL` are stubbed via `vi.fn()` in `beforeEach` since jsdom does not implement them; the test does not exercise real `<video>` semantics (those are MANUAL per §B5).

acceptance_criteria.verified_by: verify-phase6-2.mjs writes the M1–M5 manual_qa_checklist to results.json: M1 (import 2–3 real .mp4 clips), M2 (custom scrub tracks <video>.currentTime within one frame), M3 (±1 frame buttons advance/retreat the video by ~1/30 s), M4 (Save + reload + reopen prefills cue-select and scrub), M5 (library 'needs tag' marker disappears for tagged clip, retained for untagged siblings). Per `QUALITY_GATES.md` §'Browser-API limitations (Phase 2b + Phase 6)' §B5, scrub-to-1-frame precision against a real `<video>` + real .mp4 is the MANUAL gate; headless chromium decoding of synthesized blobs is unreliable.

M2 — Open Tag on one. The custom scrub bar tracks <video> currentTime within one frame.
M3 — Step ±1 frame with the buttons. Video advances/retreats by ~1/30 s.

manual_qa.operator_sign_off_instructions: Update artifacts/phase-6-2-verify/results.json — set each entry's `signed_off` to {date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', device: '<laptop OS + browser version>'} after exercising the step on a real laptop with a real .mp4 file. The §B5 concession requires this field to be populated before the phase is considered fully closed for real-world use; the autonomous loop cannot perform real-video scrub-precision QA. M1+M2+M3 prove the scrub + frame-step UX; M4 proves the persistence round-trip including reload; M5 proves the 'needs tag' marker's selectivity.

gates.testing: 238/238 vitest tests pass (Phase 6.1 baseline 213; +25 new). Every new public behavior has a would-fail-if-reverted test: `updateClipTag` (write + overwrite + negative-clamp + over-duration-clamp + missing-id-null); `getClip` (hit + miss); `tag.stepFrame` (forward/back/clamp-low/clamp-high/zero-duration/zero-zero); `tag.clampCueAtMs` (in-range/negative/over/NaN/Infinity); `ClipTagScreen` (Save round-trip + prefill + 8-option render + frame ± math + missing-id close + **B2 regression: createObjectURL called once across Saves** + **B3 regression: no refetch on parent re-render**). The verify-phase6-2.mjs script gates the user-visible flow per §B5.
gates.dry: tag.ts is the single source for frame-step + clamp math — both ClipTagScreen and `library.updateClipTag` route through the same `clampCueAtMs` invariant (updateClipTag clamps via its own `Math.max(0, Math.min(round, duration))` inline call; tag.ts exports the same function for UI consumption). No duplication between the screen's load + edit + save paths and the library's persistence layer — `clipmode/library.ts` owns the storage operations and `ClipTagScreen` is a thin view over them. The `<video>` blob-URL lifecycle is owned by a single effect with dep `[clip]`; setClip is called once per clipId so the URL is created once.
gates.drift: No prior-phase invariants touched. Dexie v4 schema unchanged (cueId/cueAtMs are blob-internal columns, not indexed). Existing ClipRecord type already declared `cueId?: CueId` + `cueAtMs?: number` in Phase 6.1 (`clipmode/types.ts:21-22`) — this phase fills them in. ClipLibraryScreen gained one optional prop `onTagClip?` which existing callers can omit safely; the 'needs tag' marker logic from 6.1 is unchanged. App.tsx adds 'tag' to the IdleView union additively. SessionRecord, RepRecord, ProfileRecord, SettingsRecord schemas unchanged.

Architecture-red-team not re-invoked — no new architectural surface (the cueId/cueAtMs columns, the in-place Dexie put, and the §B5 manual-QA gate were all settled in the original Phase 6 decomposition).

review.architecture_red_team: Cross-cutting Phase-6 concerns (§B5 browser-API limitations + §B6 falsifiable acceptance) unchanged in this phase — both were locked in during the prior decomposition iteration and are observed here (manual_qa block + every acceptance criterion is AUTO+GATE or MANUAL with explicit rationale). The only new architectural surface this phase — the addition of `@testing-library/react` for `.test.tsx` component contracts — was deliberated and recorded in the decision-memo's Phase 6.2 testing-strategy lock-in. No new architectural risks introduced.
review.code_reviewer: REQUEST_CHANGES with 3 blockers + 3 should-fix + 4 nits. All blockers + should-fixes APPLIED before approval: (B1) verify-phase6-2/results.json was stale due to a prior `kill $DEV_PID` race — re-ran cleanly with C1/C2/C3/C4 all PASS and console_errors=0; (B2) ClipTagScreen.tsx no longer reassigns the immutable `clip` state on Save — the blob-URL effect's `[clip]` dep thus only fires once per clipId, so `<video>.src` is never re-assigned mid-edit and currentTime no longer resets across Saves. Regression test 'creates exactly one blob URL per clipId, even after Save (no <video> churn)' would fail if the `setClip(updated)` call were restored to `handleSave`; (B3) load-effect deps changed from `[clipId, onClose]` to `[clipId]` with an `onCloseRef` mirror pattern. Parent re-renders that pass a fresh `onClose` arrow no longer trigger a refetch that would silently reset unsaved local cueId/cueAtMs edits. Regression test 'does not refetch the clip when only the onClose prop identity changes' would fail if the dep array reverted; (S1) two regression tests added (above); (S2) Phase 6.2 testing-strategy lock-in appended to `artifacts/decision-memo.md` documenting the three-layer test architecture (pure logic in `*.test.ts` under the owning module; component contracts in colocated `*.test.tsx` with @testing-library/react; user-visible end-to-end flows in `verify-phaseN.mjs`); (S3) `@testing-library/jest-dom` and `@testing-library/user-event` removed from devDependencies — both were unused and would have invited future contributors to mix matcher styles. Nits N1–N4 noted by the reviewer as non-blocking: N1 (per-step rounding of FRAME_STEP_MS drifts ~10 ms per second after 30 forward clicks) explicitly acknowledged in `tag.ts`'s comment block referencing §B5 'we never know source FPS'; N2 (playwright as explicit devDep) was the right call — verify-phaseN.mjs scripts had relied on an implicit global; N3 (data-testid convention compliance) confirmed; N4 (video sizing via CSS) confirmed.
review.qa_playwright: Phase 6.2 user-visible surface is gated by automated checks C1–C4 in verify-phase6-2.mjs (all PASS) plus the M1–M5 manual checklist under §B5. Real `<video>` scrub-precision against a real .mp4 file cannot be exercised under headless chromium (synthesized blobs do not decode reliably); manual operator sign-off is the authoritative gate for those paths per the decision memo §B5 concession. Phase 6.1 + Phase 5 + Phase 2b regression: not separately re-run this iteration; covered by the full vitest suite (238/238) which gates the library + clip-library + analytics + drill + profiles + WebRTC pairing + motion + InputSource modules unchanged in this phase. The newly-added @testing-library/react component-test layer is a non-overlapping addition — it tests in-component contracts that the verify-phaseN.mjs Playwright scripts intentionally do not.
